# Chapter 1: Rested Dough

## 1.1 What Rest Does

Rested dough feels the same every time you touch it. A baker who has shaped one loaf can shape the next, because the flour has had time to take up the water.

Flour takes up water slowly, so dough shaped in a hurry tears in the hand [@Doe20]. A long rest helps only when the kitchen is *warm* enough.

## Summary

Rested dough is dough a baker can shape.
